name: What is a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition expands your home's footprint by adding new enclosed living space. This can include anything from an extra bedroom or bathroom to a larger kitchen or a new family room. Room additions are a popular way to increase living space and property value without moving, and they are typically built to match the existing architectural style of your home.
